context:
Goal: the new CI job for your pick b on item 279 replays each model judge's known cases, so a judge that drifts is caught before merge.
Why yours: the job needs a Claude sign-in in CI. Making the token is your login, and no cloud session can add a repo secret. Without the secret, the job reads "unknown" and turns red (decision ci-unknown-is-red).
Paste the command below in a terminal on your computer. The first line prints a token: copy it. The last line asks for the secret's value: paste the token there. GitHub does not pass the secret to PRs from forks, so it stays private.
Or, in the browser: open the link, set Name to CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, paste the token as Secret, and press Add secret.
